source_paper: Kachuri et al. 2019, Int J Epidemiol (never sent to the agent; see replication/kachuri2019/paper_card.md)
question: Is genetically predicted longer leukocyte telomere length causally associated with the risk of lung cancer (overall, adenocarcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma) and of head and neck (oral and pharyngeal) cancer? Report each effect as an odds ratio per 1 kb longer telomere length.
data_description:
exposure_telomere_length_snps.tsv: genome-wide significant SNPs for leukocyte telomere length from published European-ancestry GWAS. beta_kb = change in telomere length (kb) per copy of long_allele; p = GWAS p-value. No standard errors are given. Some SNPs may be in linkage disequilibrium with each other.
outcome_lung_*.tsv: European-ancestry lung cancer case-control GWAS summary statistics (log-odds betas per effect_allele).
outcome_hnc_set_*.tsv: two independent European-ancestry oral/pharyngeal cancer case-control GWAS (log-odds betas per effect_allele).
Outcome files are restricted to the exposure SNPs and some high-LD proxies. Some exposure SNPs are missing from some files or appear under a different rsID.
